title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

suppliers.sup:70510: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Part 350011 – 7.5 kW motor, terms from 01/2027
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and the long partnership.

Our forecast fc:350011@2026-09 records an 11.9 % volume increase for this motor, to 6110 pieces a year.
Our scorecard sc:70510@2026Q3 shows 90.4 % on-time delivery for the last quarter.
The same scorecard sc:70510@2026Q3 records 273 ppm, above the 250 ppm in your standard terms.

The attached packages cover 6110 pieces a year over 12 months. The longer payment options are meant to ease your cash and margin position. Could your pricing committee review them at its next meeting? We would also welcome any cheaper design variant you could offer.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Part 350011 – 7.5 kW motor, terms from 01/2027
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have verified the volume increase in your forecast and noted the quality record, which allows us to adjust our calculation. We can accept your terms and await your order. 

Our current Angebot includes a price of €361.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our technical department will address your inquiry regarding a more cost-effective design variant separately. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Application Engineering: Please note that we build strictly according to your provided drawing, and we do not propose any design changes.
